notice: These are published ranges from third-party literature, not measurements of any provider's datacenter. LeanRigor cannot observe provider hardware, batching, utilization or cooling, so every figure derived from this file is an estimate with a stated range and must be presented as such.

sources.title: From Tokens to Watt-hours
sources.usedFor: separating prefill from decode; exposing hardware assumptions rather than folding them into one constant

sources.title: Energy Use of AI Inference
sources.usedFor: bottom-up estimates require throughput, utilization and PUE assumptions; range width reflects those unknowns

sources.title: The Compression Paradox in LLM Inference
sources.usedFor: token reduction is not a reliable energy proxy; compression can expand output and increase total energy

sources.title: Towards Green AI for Software Development
sources.usedFor: prefill volume affects decoding energy; suppressing unnecessary output can reduce energy

sources.title: Green Software Foundation — Software Carbon Intensity
sources.usedFor: functional unit, disclosure of assumptions, and the requirement that grid intensity be supplied rather than assumed

large.description: Roughly over 100B active parameters, or an undisclosed frontier model.

unknown.description: Model family not disclosed. The range spans every class above, because narrowing it would be invention rather than estimation.

infrastructureOverhead.description: Multiplier covering power usage effectiveness, networking and idle capacity. Applied to the compute estimate.

cacheReadDiscount.description: Fraction of prefill energy attributed to a cache-read token. Cache reads still cost work; the discount is deliberately conservative because the true figure is not published.
